issue.title: http: Expect: 100-continue not handled, curl/libcurl POSTs over 1 MiB stall ~1 s
issue.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Current behaviour

The new HTTP server (#35182) ignores `Expect: 100-continue`. curl/libcurl sends this header for POST bodies over 1 MiB and waits up to 1s for `100 Continue` before sending the body anyway, so every such request is delayed by ~1 s.

[RFC 9110 §10.1.1 requires](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-10.1.1-14) an origin server receiving `Expect: 100-continue` to either send `100 Continue` or an immediate final status. The previous libevent-based server sent `100 Continue`.

Affected RPCs include `submitblock` (full blocks in hex exceed 1 MiB), large `sendrawtransaction`/`submitpackage`, big PSBTs and JSON-RPC batches. `bitcoin-cli` and most JSON-RPC libraries don't send `Expect`, and requests still succeed, just ~1 s later.

### Expected behaviour

Follow RFC 9110 §10.1.1 and reply with `100 Continue` or an immediate final status.

### Steps to reproduce

```sh
python3 -c 'print("{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"echo\",\"params\":[\"" + "a"*2_000_000 + "\"]}")' > big.json
curl -v -u "$(cat ~/.bitcoin/regtest/.cookie)" --data-binary @big.json http://127.0.0.1:18443/ -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n'
```

v32.0rc3 output:

```
> Expect: 100-continue
>
* Done waiting for 100-continue
...
1.029281
```

v31.0 output:

```
> Expect: 100-continue
>
< HTTP/1.1 100 Continue
...
0.052923
```
